content_sections.heading: TISS Junior Engineer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TISS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: TISS Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TISS Junior Engineer (Electrical) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TISS Junior Engineer (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.E./ B. Tech./ Diploma in Electrical Engineering to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) post at TISS.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum experience required for this role?
faq.answer: A minimum of one year of relevant experience in Electrical Engineering is required for this position.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the TISS located?
faq.answer: TISS is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400088.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
